issue.title: test_ace_page_restores_fast_startup_overrides_after_success sees a leaked _collect_artifacts_project_choices override in the scoped check lane

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by phase sase-1jm.9.6 (note #1), triaged by the sase-1jm.9 land agent.

Fail/pass observations: `sase tool failures` groups this node (signature d8060e7ed416…) as NEW in 3 scoped `just check` runs by 3 different agents in 3 workspaces between 2026-10-11 16:47 EDT and 2026-10-12 19:07 EDT (latest ToolRun a99f505beba6839e342b3fe9df362063, serial 1-worker scoped lane, 84 min). It passes in isolation at master 1230bb32c1 (`.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_ace_testing.py::test_ace_page_restores_fast_startup_overrides_after_success`) and passed in sase-1jm.9.6's focused clean-base rerun. First seen before epic sase-1jm.9 existed, so that epic did not cause it.

Failure (from the a99f505b log): tests/test_ace_testing.py:346 `assert artifacts_actions._collect_artifacts_project_choices is not originals[5]` fails because `originals[5]` is ALREADY `_empty_artifacts_project_choices` (src/sase/ace/testing/_startup.py:238) when the test captures its originals, i.e. an earlier test in the same process left the fast-startup override for `sase.ace.tui.actions.artifacts._collect_artifacts_project_choices` installed (or a monkeypatch captured the patched value and restored it). Order-dependent leak of module-global test state, not a timing flake; the leaking test is not yet identified. Candidates: tests that monkeypatch "sase.ace.tui.actions.artifacts._collect_artifacts_project_choices" while an AcePage fast-startup override is active (tests/ace/tui/test_link_follow_bounded_panes.py:364, test_artifacts_files_filtering.py, test_commits_pane_filters.py, test_artifacts_plans_grouping.py), or an AcePage exit path that skips restoring the override (src/sase/ace/testing/_startup.py:399-406).
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: just check (scoped serial lane); passes alone: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_ace_testing.py::test_ace_page_restores_fast_startup_overrides_after_success

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1jm.9 phase .6 proposed this follow-up; three check runs by different agents recorded the failure, and its cause (an earlier test leaking the AcePage fast-startup override) is not caused by sase-1jm.9.

payload.entry: Reproduced the ordered leak at 850b9fdfcb in one serial pytest process: test_archived_plan_reveals_through_path_context_after_scan then test_ace_page_restores_fast_startup_overrides_after_success failed at tests/_ace_testing_startup.py:205 because originals[5] was already _empty_artifacts_project_choices. Cause: _open_plans applied function-scoped monkeypatch to _collect_artifacts_project_choices after AcePage entry, so pytest restored the empty helper after page exit. Fix: _install_truncated_archived_plans patches before AcePage (same pattern as _open_stitches / _mounted_pane). Ordered pair plus entry-points caller passed 3/3 serial rounds after the fix; added nested-context and helper lifecycle regressions. No other post-AcePage setters of this function remain outside the new nested-context test.
